wallpapers.title: An act of wilderness
wallpapers.caption: Coyote Buttes, Vermilion Cliffs National Monument, Arizona
wallpapers.desc: Waves usually belong to the ocean. In northern Arizona, they rise from the desert instead. The swirling sandstone formations of Coyote Buttes, part of Vermilion Cliffs National Monument, were shaped by ancient dunes and millions of years of erosion, creating a landscape that seems to ripple even while standing still.
